name: Dungeon
note: The world's manifest (docs/order-plan.md, sprint D). `show` is MapShow, read by game/world/world_show.cpp: what the client draws, plays and hears here. A system opens only where its field is set. Copied to assets/world/<w>/world.json by tools/sync.sh.

show.places_note: Its three floors, flood-filled off the attribute grid (OpenMU Version075 Gates.cs:48-50; docs/dungeon-port.md 1.2). The first box holding a tile names it.

air.note: aDungeon, looped for the whole map (SceneManager.cpp:859-861); a hall's reverb.

indoors.note: No open sky on any tile (MU draws it on its black clear, SceneManager.cpp:402).

boids.note: MODEL_BAT01 (GOBoid.cpp:1327-1328): the bird's 1.0, its light and its 0.5 (GOBoid.cpp:1316-1320), SOUND_BAT01 alone. The cook spaces its four keys 0.25 s apart, so 6.25 for MU's key a frame at 0.04 s.

crawls.note: MoveFishs' WD_1DUNGEON arm (GOBoid.cpp:1720-1722). Agrees with tools/cook.py's CRAWLS.

void_clouds.note: In its cellar's warm grey rather than the castle's cold one (the user, 2026-10-02: 'really nice clouds for BC, lets alos use them on dungeon black voids').

hidden.note: The Dungeon's five (ZzzObject.cpp:3872-3897, 4660-4664): 39, 40 and 51 are the lance, iron-stick and fire traps, hidden as scenery because the server's trap monster draws the same model; 52 is the falling-stone emitter and 60 the lean box, which has no .bmd.

grass.note: The Dungeon ships no TileGrass .OZT, and its TileGrass01 is the stone floor under 76% of the map: none, said outright, so a slot's name never sows a lawn underground.

water_flow.note: The Dungeon's cave streams: 25 channels of 40 tiles or more along the rock, each fed at one end and drained at the other -- the two ends furthest apart along it, found by walking the water. MU's ground is flat here and says nothing of which way they run; the way is ours. The small pools are left out, and stand still.

60.model: Object61, the lean box, invisible and with no .bmd

perches.note: the Dungeon: MOVEMENT_OPERATE's WD_1DUNGEON arm (ZzzInterface.cpp:1705-1712), 60 on RenderCursor's lean list (:4053) and given the 160-unit box (ZzzObject.cpp:4661-4663)
